resume_mentor.text:
Brave Traveler {display_name}, the path tightens — your scroll shows a prerequisite still unwoven. Tend to the quests your facilitator grouped as prerequisites, then return to {realm_display_name}.

The directive reads: "{required_next_action}"

mentor_default.text: The Codex remembers your steps, {display_name}. Let the directive — "{required_next_action}" — be the only compass you need in {realm_display_name}.

master_scribe_default.text: The main path reads "{active_main_quest_title}". When you finish a worksheet row, the Scribe's tally updates on save — no separate ritual required.
Ink dries fast on the Manifest, Traveler. Cross-check your quest log against what your facilitator expects in Forms — the Scribe's margin notes follow the same columns as your save row.

oracle_default.text: Smoke lifts from the Mirror of Maia, {display_name}. What you rehearse here in {realm_display_name} should echo in your Maia Learning reflections — the Oracle only repeats what data already whispers.

guild_manager_default.text: Side contracts stay green in the quest log until turned in — guild policy, Traveler. Clear side tiers before you petition for guild hall research credit.
Charters are stamped when saves land in Sheets, not when you merely pause. If your facilitator assigned a comparison ledger, finish the fields before you chase the next waypoint.

realm_lore.text: Aethelwood's roots drink slow rain, {display_name}. Here the Oracle counsels patience: fog lifts only where your quest sheet says you have already walked.
